opening.argument: The video pairs a 624% APY claim with a concrete account of returns: the narrator says, “I am staking $10,000 worth of tokens,” reports “about 1.7% daily returns on my $10,000,” and says the amount increased by about $170. It then moves from those claims to participation, directing viewers to “connect” a wallet and instructing them to “click stake and confirm the transaction in our wallet.” This is a direct promotion of staking Pudgy Penguins through an external service, with unusually high stated returns and step-by-step instructions involving wallet access and consequential funds. The educational disclaimer does not erase the force of those promotional claims and instructions.

citations.quote: Pudgy Penguins Staking Guide 🚀 How to Earn 624% APY on Jupiter
I am staking $10,000 worth of tokens.
My staked amount has increased by about $170.
Here's the Jupyter website to connect, I click the Connect Wallet button.
Now, let us click stake and confirm the transaction in our wallet.
